entities.summary: Andrew James Trauth is an American actor and singer. Trauth is known for playing Alan Twitty on Even Stevens and Josh Mankey on Kim Possible, both programs which aired on Disney Channel. Furthermore, Trauth is a vocalist for the pop rock trio Mavin, which he formed with his two brothers in 2002. The trio performed the theme song to another Disney Channel property, American Dragon: Jake Long.
